class.name: MVVehicle
class.brief_description: Root node of a modular vehicle.
class.description: A [RigidBody3D] that will discover its [code]MVWheel[/code] descendants and run the vehicle simulation. This scaffold version only exposes the centre of gravity; the physics arrives in later branches.

members.member: Centre of mass of the body in local space, in metres. Setting it switches the body to [constant RigidBody3D.CENTER_OF_MASS_MODE_CUSTOM].
